extraction.Name: Charles Dion
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 28, 1918, but records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: April 21, 1924, Dion and wife conveyed the land by deed to the American State Bank of Burke for $1.00 and other valuable consideration, subject to mortgages amounting to $10,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612798; Northwest quarter section 35, township 98, range 72; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 14, 1918; on March 22, 1918, Charles and Eva Dion mortgaged the land to Peters Trust Company of Omaha for $2000; between March 1918 and April 21, 1924, the land was mortgaged on eleven different occasions; wife named Eva Dion. Document also contains a separate entry for Joseph Dion (Allotment No. 3147), Fee patent No. 612799, Southwest quarter section 35, township 98, range 72, issued December 29, 1917, recorded March 30, 1918; mortgaged to Peters Trust Company of Omaha for $2500 due April 1, 1923; mortgaged to American State Bank of Burke for $1000 due May 16, 1919; on February 26, 1920, land again mortgaged to Peters Trust Company for $6000 due April 1, 1925; on July 24, 1926, foreclosure proceedings had and land sold to Peters Trust Company; on July 26, 1927, sheriff conveyed land by deed to Peters Trust Company on account of the mortgage.
